title: The Dog
author: William Youatt
description: "The Dog" by William Youatt is a scientific publication first published in the mid-19th century.
longDescription: The book examines the history, classification, and various characteristics of dogs, emphasizing their unique bond with humans and their varied roles in society.

authorInfo.bio: William Youatt (1776–1847) wrote The Dog. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
